text: As a pro videographer and editor I came into this with low expectations. Windows on Arm has been a mess over the years and no one has anything good to say about these new chips. In contrast I am extremely impressed with the performance on day one. The rebuilt version of Premier Pro for N1X performs better than anything I've experienced on windows mobile. 6 streams of 4k 422 10 bit, animated graphics, and color mastering with not a single hiccup. For Premier specifically this laptop performs on par with my 4090 PC in terms of timeline playback. Exporting is significantly slower. Even Lightroom Classic running through prism emulation is incredibly fast with full support for GPU acceleration and instant subject detection and fast performance inside AI tools like objects removal and denoise. All to say extremely impressive for a bass trim with 24 GB of RAM. The laptop itself is incredibly well built, matching and even beating MacBooks in my opinion. Battery life is fantastic. Not nearly as good as MacBooks but by far the best in window for creative task. Under full load the laptop stays fairly quiet on par with my MacBook m2 max. Fantastic Port selection and a super clean install of windows. The biggest problem with this device is the display. The mini LED display has a lot of ghosting and the backlighting zones are slow to respond. Sometimes leaves dimming ghosting trails behind moving objects on a bright background. This would be the perfect machine if it had an OLED. If you're a creative that uses the Adobe creative suite, specifically Premier Pro and needs Windows or doesn't want a MacBook. This is a fantastic machine.
title: The best Window has to offer, for certain task
